|lore=Stormtroopers blasted through the main airlock of the ''Tantive IV''. The Rebel soldiers’ attempt to defend the intrusion was no match for the Empire’s superior firepower.
|game_text=Deploy on a captured starship. Your characters on your Star Destroyer (or in Docking Bay 327) may battle opponent's characters on captured starship, as if at a site. If your characters are eliminated, starship escapes.

|reviews=* [[Jeff Hansen]], "Besieged", Neglected Card Series, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] (2000). Hansen notes it lets characters present with a captured starship battle those trapped aboard, making it possible to steal starships with crews. "extremely powerful when you can mercilessly spank a lone pilot."<ref name="hansen-neglected29">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles/neglected29.html "Besieged" review], Jeff Hansen, Neglected Card Series, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091023064523/http://geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles/neglected29.html Internet Archive]. Listed on the site's [http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Articles page] by 14 October 2000. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001014155851/http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|rulings=* [[Besieged]] is canceled if Dark steals the starship.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Besieged (GEMP ID 2_117, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), records both statements as later rulings. The [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 163, explains that Besieged goes to Dark's Lost Pile when Dark steals the captured starship, while it remains attached when the released starship launches. This is later rules evidence, not a transcription of the original printed face. Historical limitation: Decipher's [https://web.archive.org/web/20061215115652/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Glossary Version 2.0] (November 1998), p. 25, adds cancellation on escape or theft but also says Besieged remains until the ship leaves table regardless of controller. That conflicting explanation is not resolved by this citation. Preserved data copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Besieged Scomp: Besieged].</ref>
* The starship being a stolen starship currently owned by Light, does not cause [[Besieged]] to be canceled.
